title: Click First or Last? Strategic Order Submission During the Euronext Preopening Session
authors: Laurence Daures; Sophie Moinas; Selma Boussetta
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. Stock-day (and stock-day-trader-type) regressions of preopening order submission and price discovery on trader-type dummies, order-imbalance measures and tick-size/earnings/liquidity-event dummies with stock FE only (Tables 3-5, 9; IV. Producing Tables and Figures.do lines 462-564). The natural experiment (Tables 6-8) is the June 6, 2013 Euronext preopening outage, a single date, estimated with endogenous-treatment corrections (etregress twostep; probit + regress with inverse Mills ratio mylambda) on cross-sections of delayed-opening days.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe, regress, probit). Euronext Paris / Chi-X, 97 SBF120 stocks, May 2012-Dec 2013.

specs.exclusion_reason: trader-type and tick-change dummies with time-varying controls, stock FE only; no adoption design
single-date outage (June 6, 2013); cross-sectional treatment-effects regression (etregress twostep / probit + OLS with inverse Mills ratio)

data_files_note: README.docx: Eurofidai-Bedofih intraday data are not distributed; the README mentions a small mockup subsample (816 stock-days for the delayed-opening analysis), but the archive contains only Code/, Logs/ and README/.
data_provenance_note: No data files in the archive (the mockup subsample described in the README is absent).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Market-microstructure regressions and a single-date outage; no data.
